rows.criterion: A work item may declare praxis.work-risk/1 metadata: change class, risk level, persistent-state impact, external protocol/provider impact, security/privacy impact, failure posture (fail-open, fail-closed, indeterminate), tier ownership and required live/integration proof, set by work capture/update flags and shown by work context.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: the work update risk options parse into a validated declaration; cli: risk metadata on a high-risk persistence item makes design debt and a matrix completion obligations (work update --change-class ... then work context shows risk and obligations)

rows.criterion: Invalid values are refused at capture/update.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: risk metadata needs a change class and, with impact, a failure posture; an invalid risk declaration rejects the update; praxis.work-risk/1 round-trips and refuses unknown values

rows.criterion: Completion obligations (design-debt declaration, verification-matrix dimensions) are derived from the metadata by a pure domain function.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: high-risk work owes a design-debt declaration; persistence work owes a matrix with concurrency but no live effect; remote-execution work and a declared live proof owe a live effect
completion obligations: work without risk metadata has no obligations; cli: an item without risk metadata completes exactly as before

rows.criterion: Tests cover parsing, validation and obligation derivation.

evidence.result: riskTests cover parsing, validation and obligation derivation

rows.criterion: Completion accepts --evidence design-debt=PATH, a praxis.design-debt/1 document declaring either no known design debt or debt entries referencing captured work items with rationale, risk and the compromised boundary.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: praxis.design-debt/1 decoding is strict; a declaration of no known debt passes; debt tracked by a recorded open item passes

rows.criterion: A design-debt-declared facet joins the A052 completion-readiness record.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: the gate records every consumed evidence file with its digest (designDebtDeclared facet satisfied in the readiness record)

rows.criterion: For high-risk work (from PRAXIS-QUAL-07 metadata), a missing declaration or debt referencing no recorded non-terminal work item refuses completion (exit 3, no state change).

evidence.reference: completion obligations: untracked debt fails: the item itself or an unrecorded or closed item; cli: high-risk item refused (exit 3) without a declaration and with untracked debt, item stays active

rows.criterion: A declared prototype cannot complete as canonical without a debt entry.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: a prototype cannot become canonical without a debt entry

rows.criterion: Completion accepts --evidence verification-matrix=PATH, a praxis.verification-matrix/1 document with rows for happy path, negative/failure, corruption/partial state, concurrency, compatibility/version skew, recovery/rollback and representative live effect, each met, not-applicable (with reason) or not-met, with evidence.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: praxis.verification-matrix/1 decoding is strict; a complete matrix with real evidence passes

rows.criterion: A verification-matrix facet joins the A052 completion-readiness record.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: cli: matrix satisfied facet recorded as satisfied on completion

rows.criterion: For stateful control-plane, persistence, release/bootstrap, security or remote-execution work (from PRAXIS-QUAL-07 change class), a missing matrix or any required dimension not met refuses completion; unit-test or build evidence alone never satisfies it.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: a missing required dimension, a not-met row and a not-applicable required row fail; compilation or unit tests alone never satisfy the matrix; a met row needs evidence, a live effect needs live evidence, and locations must exist; cli refusal without a matrix

evidence.result: targeted suites passed: CompletionObligations, QualityEvidence, WorkUpdate*, CliBoundaryRatchet, Architecture, WorkGroup

rows.criterion: Every consumed evidence file (dokimos-ratchet, ordo-boundary and the new design-debt, verification-matrix and release-readiness documents) is recorded with its sha256 digest in the completion-readiness record.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: the digest of a consumed evidence file is the sha256 of its bytes; the gate records every consumed evidence file with its digest; cli: consumedEvidence carries sha256 for design-debt and verification-matrix

rows.criterion: A praxis.release-readiness/1 contract is documented and consumed through --evidence release-readiness=PATH: release identity, the checks run and their results; release-ready is satisfied only by a consistent document whose checks all passed, unavailable when absent, malformed or inconsistent.

evidence.reference: completion obligations: a ready release whose checks all passed is release-ready; a ready verdict over a failed or skipped check is inconsistent; a not-ready release fails; a required release-ready facet is unavailable without evidence and satisfied with it; praxis.release-readiness/1 decoding is strict

rows.criterion: requirements/CODE-QUALITY-HARDENING.md drops both items from its not-yet-done list.

evidence.result: PRX-QUAL-023 update note replaces the not-yet-done list

rows.criterion: Tests cover digest recording and each release-readiness outcome.
